name: Dakshineswar Kali Temple, Kolkata
path: Dakshineswar Kali Temple, Kolkata, Kolkata, India
summary: 19th-century Navaratna architectural temple on the Hooghly river where Sri Ramakrishna Paramahamsa served as priest.
points: Founded in 1855 CE by the philanthropist queen Rani Rashmoni
Dedicated to Goddess Bhavatarini (an aspect of Kali); classic Bengal Navaratna (nine-spire) style
Spiritual seat where 19th-century mystic Sri Ramakrishna Paramahamsa attained divine visions

name: Victoria Memorial
summary: Magnificent white Makrana marble monument dedicated to Queen Victoria, surrounded by 64-acre gardens.
points: Built between 1906 and 1921 CE, designed by Sir William Emerson in Indo-Saracenic revival style
Constructed from pure white Makrana marble quarried from Jodhpur, Rajasthan
Houses 25 galleries containing 28,000 historic artifacts, paintings, and royal archives
